title: Claude Duet review- Great design, but...

facts.fact: The video is an early review of Claude Duet, Anthropic's new personal agent, a phone app (iPhone/Android) synced with Claude and aimed at small business owners and busy professionals.
facts.trap: Claude Duet is a desktop app, or it was made by OpenAI.
facts.note: Captions write 'cloud' for Claude in places. The reviewer had early TestFlight / research-preview access.

evidence.quote: It is a phone, iPhone, Android based personal agent that is synced up with Claude

facts.fact: The reviewer praises its exceptionally polished design and onboarding, plus features like task lists, artifacts and Slack-like channels, and says it inherits Claude's plugins and connectors.
facts.trap: The reviewer criticizes the design or calls the app unpolished.
facts.note: Compared with competitors the transcript names 'Dots' (OpenAI/Codex's agent, said to be far less polished), 'Muse' (once 'Muse Meta') and 'Grockbot'; names come from auto-captions and may be misheard, so a summary shouldn't be penalized for omitting them.

evidence.quote: the polish of the agent design. This app is beautiful.

facts.fact: The main criticisms: it isn't proactive enough (after setup it never pulled him back) and it is slow, with tasks taking 10+ minutes, so it fails to close loops and he forgot about it.
facts.trap: The reviewer says it is fast or too noisy/annoying.

evidence.quote: it's slow, man. And I get so disengaged waiting for the models to finish.

facts.fact: Also missing: there is no desktop app, and it is single-player only, with no way to share agents with his small team.

evidence.quote: Duet right now is clearly a agent for single player use.

facts.fact: Verdict: worth trying and well made, but it fell to the bottom of his use list and he doubts it will become part of his own agent stack; it does not replace his current agents.
facts.trap: The reviewer says Claude Duet will become his main personal agent.

evidence.quote: let me know if Claude Duet becomes part of your stack because I'm just not sure it's going to become part of mine.
